modmenu.summaryTranslation.lava_boat_clu: Be fixin' the lava boat clutch mechanic, arr, I reckon!
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.lava_boat:
Restores the lava boat clutch mechanic that them scallywags fixed in 1.21.5.

On first contact wit' the lava, the boat gets a short immunity, so ye can land on its hitbox, arr!

Now ye can do lava clutches like Dream but in newer versions, yarr!
config.lava_boat_clutch.title: Lava Boat Clutch Fix Settings, Arr!
config.lava_boat_clutch.enable_mod.toolt: Enables or disables the lava boat clutch mechanic, arr.
config.lava_boat_clutch.immunity_ticks.t: The number of plunks in which the boat not be burnin' in the lava, yarr.
config.lava_boat_clutch.bounce_drop_mode:
Vanilla Seas: uses vanilla velocity, arr
Pirate's Choice: uses configurable velocity, yarr.
Random: random velocity, arr.
config.lava_boat_clutch.bounce_drop_y.to: Upward velocity applied to the boat's drop after boat burn in lava, yarr.
config.lava_boat_clutch.bounce_drop_x.to: Lateral velocity along the X axis applied to the boat's drop after boat burn in lava, arr.
config.lava_boat_clutch.bounce_drop_z.to: Lateral velocity along the Z axis applied to the boat's drop after boat burn in lava, yarr.
